guidance.title: Guidance
guidance.introduction: This platform connects environmental contributors with companies seeking certified carbon credits. If you grow crops or trees that help reduce air pollution, this system helps you earn money for your impact.
guidance.step1_description: Add your UPI details to verify that the land is yours. This ensures transparency and trusted data.
guidance.step2_description: Take clear photos of your crops or trees that reduce carbon emissions. Upload them for verification.
guidance.step3_description: After review, your contributions to air conservation generate credits based on certified standards.
guidance.step4_description: Companies purchase credits to offset emissions. You earn money directly through your connected wallet.
guidance.contribution: Your contribution matters. Every tree, every crop, every square meter of land helping reduce pollution is a step toward a greener future. Thank you for making a difference!

admin.faq_ai_scoring: How does the AI credit scoring system work?
admin.faq_ai_scoring_answer: The AI system analyzes submitted documents and user information to verify legitimacy of credit applications. It checks for document authenticity, cross-references user data, and assesses risk factors. The system provides a legality score and recommendation for admin approval.
admin.faq_farmer_docs: What documents are required for farmer verification?
admin.faq_farmer_docs_answer: Farmers need to provide: Land Certificate/Title Deed, Recent Farm Photos, Production Records (last 3 months), and Proof of Residence. All documents must be clear and legible.
admin.faq_create_listing: How do I create a new credit listing?
admin.faq_create_listing_answer: Go to Credit Sales > Create New Listing. Fill in the listing name, select sector, enter quantity and price per credit. Review the total value and publish. Credits will be available for buyer purchase immediately.
admin.faq_commission_answer: Commission rates vary by sector: Farmer (5%), Eco Stoves (6%), Hybrid Vehicles (4%), Commercial (7%). These are deducted from each sale automatically.
admin.faq_wallet_source: Where do the credits in the admin wallet come from?
admin.faq_wallet_source_answer: Credits in the admin wallet come from verified users who earn them through their activities (farming, eco stoves, etc.). The system collects these credits and stores them for management and resale.
admin.faq_payouts_answer: Payouts are distributed based on the sector contribution percentage and the fee structure. Monthly reconciliation ensures accurate distribution to all participating sectors.
admin.faq_manage_users: How do I manage user accounts?
admin.faq_manage_users_answer: In System Users, you can view all registered users, filter by sector and status, and perform actions like suspending or deleting accounts. Use the actions menu on each user row.
admin.faq_user_statuses: What are the different user statuses?
admin.faq_user_statuses_answer: Active: User is verified and can trade. Pending: Awaiting verification. Suspended: Account is restricted. Inactive: User hasn't been active in 60+ days.

landing.hero_description: A digital platform that enables micro carbon credit projects (small farms, households, cooperatives, clean-cookstove users, tree-planters, biogas users, solar users) to measure, verify, aggregate, and sell carbon credits through a website or mobile app.
landing.bridge_gap: We bridge the gap between small-scale land stewards and global carbon markets with technology that ensures transparency.
landing.nature_backed_desc: Credits are generated from real, verified sequestration models and on-ground audits, not just estimates.
landing.grower_first_desc: Fair pricing, transparent payouts, and capacity building for land stewards. We take the lowest fees in the industry.
landing.market_grade_desc: Audit-ready records, verifiable credits, and compliant marketplace tooling for enterprise buyers.
landing.register_parcel_desc: Projects register their carbon sequestration activities and their impact on the climate and earn credits
landing.verify_quantify_desc: We run modelled sequestration and optional field audits to mint credits.
landing.buy_retire_desc: Companies buy credits and retire them against emissions on our platform.
landing.ready_impact: Ready to make a real impact?
landing.join_hundreds: Join hundreds of companies and thousands of projects making a real difference today.
landing.empower_land: Empowering land stewards and companies to act on climate — transparently, fairly, and effectively.
